metadata.description: Prowl Claude Code plugin: real-world market data for your agents. One MCP endpoint with 444 market data tools across 17 providers (search, ads, SEO, app stores, reviews, social, trends, finance), each call billed from one USD wallet, plus a status widget that makes a running call, its progress and its cost visible in the terminal.

plugins.name: prowl
plugins.description: Adds the namespaced Prowl market data skill, the hosted Prowl MCP server, and the status widget: in-flight calls, async-session progress in the dock, session spend from the server's own billing figures, and a one-time notice when a call fails.

plugins.name: prowl-cli
plugins.description: Adds the Prowl CLI skill: drive the same 444-tool market data catalog from the shell with @prowl-ai/cli, no MCP server required.
